name: Deep Dive to Committed
description: Takes an idea through a structured deep-dive investigation, board capture, implementation, and a commit -- the rigor-first counterpart to idea-to-committed, stopping at the commit rather than at a release.
examples: deep dive on this idea, put it on the board, build it, and commit it
investigate this proposal thoroughly, then implement it and commit the work
stress-test this feature first, then break it down, build it, and commit
I want a thorough analysis of this before building it -- take it all the way to a commit
think this through properly, capture it on the board, implement it, and commit
